effective_config_authentication.note: no rerankEndpoint configured on the effective host, so the ranker=null replay matches the effective host setting; no live reranker/LLM benchmark required and none observed enabled (no scope drift)

remote_authority.precheck_call: fresh, read-only, serial get_episodes (group_ids=[development-knowledge], max_episodes=1000) executed immediately before the replay
remote_authority.drift_note: corpus grew 227 -> 256 episodes since the 13/16 snapshot (5d6b285); stored receipt alone not relied upon — fresh read-only readback performed; the +29 cohort includes an S10 diagnostic-probe artifact curated row that drives the S10 measured regression
remote_authority.proof_policy: complete, group-pure, untruncated positive remote episode membership required before any curated candidate is injectible; unavailable/truncated/wrong-group proof authorizes no indexed injection

latency.quantile_method: linear interpolation (R-7/numpy default) on ms, rounded to int

grace_70ms.method: proxy from raw component timings vs the combined 70 ms window (index read gets ~70 ms; proof gets the remainder)

latency.note: Source/pre-fetch timings are NOT native hook start/end p95. The n values reflect that N03/N04 are rejected prompt-side (no remote search call) and proof fires only when a qualifying index candidate exists.

hook_p95.reason: instrumenting the actual native hook requires a production plugin install; the effective host supports it only via the installed plugin, which this campaign does not mutate. The 300 ms native allowance remains binding.
